tagline.en: NVIDIA's Déjà View Looping Transformer — feed-forward 3D reconstruction, camera pose, and depth from multiple views.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA 的 Déjà View Looping Transformer——从多视图前馈式重建 3D 结构、相机位姿与深度。

en: DVLT (Déjà View Looping Transformer) is a 3D & 4D reconstruction model from NVIDIA's research labs. Given a set of images, it recovers 3D structure, estimates camera poses, and predicts depth — the building blocks for turning a handful of views into a coherent scene.

It follows the feed-forward transformer approach to reconstruction: rather than optimizing a scene per capture, the network infers geometry directly from the input views. Output can be exported as a GLB mesh for downstream 3D use.

In WorldFoundry, DVLT runs through a wrapper that drives the GLB export path. The model weights are distributed separately by NVIDIA under a non-commercial research and evaluation license, so you supply them locally.
zh: DVLT（Déjà View Looping Transformer）是 NVIDIA 研究团队推出的 3D 与 4D 重建模型。给定一组图像，它能恢复 3D 结构、估计相机位姿并预测深度——这些正是把少量视图拼成完整场景的基础构件。
它采用前馈 transformer 的重建思路：无需对每次采集单独优化场景，而是由网络直接从输入视图推断几何。结果可导出为 GLB 网格，便于后续 3D 使用。
在 WorldFoundry 中，DVLT 通过一个包装器运行，驱动 GLB 导出流程。模型权重由 NVIDIA 单独分发，采用非商业研究与评估许可，需你在本地自备。

whenToUse.en: Reach for DVLT when you want feed-forward 3D reconstruction from multiple images — geometry, camera pose, and depth in one pass — and can work within a research/evaluation license.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从多张图像做前馈式 3D 重建——一次得到几何、相机位姿与深度——且能接受研究/评估许可时，DVLT 是合适之选。

notFor.en: Commercial deployment: the checkpoint is released under an NVIDIA non-commercial research and evaluation license. Weights are downloaded separately, so plan for local staging.
notFor.zh: 不适合商业部署：checkpoint 采用 NVIDIA 非商业研究与评估许可。权重需单独下载，请预留本地准备时间。
